text.text: Active while wearing at least one wizard armor piece with this trait, and stacking per piece.

Per piece: +125 max mana, +5% spell power and +7% spell damage. Four pieces give +500 mana / +20% spell power / +28% spell damage. Removing a piece removes its share (recalculated every second, no relog needed).

Every piece with this trait also carries one spell slot: the Arcane Anvil only accepts items that already are spell containers, so this set is what lets you inscribe a scroll spell onto your armor (one per piece, independent of each other).
